description: Validate bank routing identifiers offline (IBAN is covered by /v1/iban-validate): US ABA routing numbers (3-7-1 checksum, Federal Reserve district, thrift / electronic ranges), SWIFT / BIC (bank, ISO country, location, branch, test and passive BICs), Mexican CLABE (checksum, bank, plaza), Argentine CBU (both check digits), Canadian routing numbers (EFT 0YYYXXXXX and MICR XXXXX-YYY, institution names), UK sort codes, Australian BSB (bank and state) and Indian IFSC (bank). Auto-detects the type from the format. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bank-id-validate
name: bank_id_validate
title: Bank Id Validate
